stories.headline: Government crisis deepens after referendum defeat as Meloni loses key ministers
stories.summary: Following the decisive No victory (53.7%) in the justice reform referendum, Prime Minister Meloni faces her first major political defeat with multiple government resignations including Justice Undersecretary Delmastro, Ministry Chief Bartolozzi, and Tourism Minister Santanchè. Meloni publicly requested Santanchè's resignation and took interim control of the Tourism Ministry.

stories.headline: Justice reform referendum decisively rejected with 53.7% voting No
stories.summary: The constitutional referendum on justice reform suffered a crushing defeat with 53.7% voting No against 46.3% Yes, marking the first major political setback for the Meloni government. High turnout exceeded expectations, with particularly strong No votes in southern regions.

stories.headline: Forza Italia crisis as Gasparri resigns and Marina Berlusconi pushes for renewal
stories.summary: Forza Italia faces internal upheaval as Senate group leader Maurizio Gasparri resigns following pressure from 14 senators. Marina Berlusconi is pushing for party renewal while Antonio Tajani's leadership faces challenges, with threats he might resign if Paolo Barelli is also forced out.

stories.headline: Cardinal Pizzaballa blocked from Jerusalem Mass, Italy convenes Israeli ambassador
stories.summary: Israeli authorities prevented Cardinal Pizzaballa from celebrating Palm Sunday Mass at the Holy Sepulchre in Jerusalem. Foreign Minister Tajani condemned the action as "unacceptable" and summoned the Israeli ambassador for clarifications, with Meloni calling it "an offense to believers."

stories.headline: Salvini promotes Strait of Messina Bridge as "Bridge of Peace" at Messina rally
stories.summary: Infrastructure Minister Salvini attended a pro-bridge rally in Messina, rebranding the controversial Strait of Messina Bridge project as a "Bridge of Peace" given current global tensions. He promised preliminary work would begin within the year and defended the project against critics.

stories.headline: Mattarella commemorates Fosse Ardeatine massacre on 82nd anniversary
stories.summary: President Mattarella laid a wreath at the Fosse Ardeatine memorial in Rome to mark the 82nd anniversary of the Nazi massacre. The ceremony honored the 335 victims and included readings of their names, with attendance from other institutional figures including La Russa and Crosetto.

stories.headline: Crosetto calls for renewed justice reforms despite referendum defeat
stories.summary: Defense Minister Crosetto urged continued efforts on justice reform despite the referendum defeat, calling for a dialogue "beyond party lines" and criticizing how the campaign was conducted. He argued the Constitution must be defended daily and expressed concerns about magistrature neutrality.

stories.headline: Bank of Italy appoints commissioners to oversee Bff Bank restructuring
stories.summary: Bank of Italy appointed two commissioners, Raffaele Lener and Francesco Fioretto, to temporarily assist Bff Bank's board following inspection findings of irregularities in factoring operations that could significantly increase bad debt provisions. The bank requested postponement of its 2025 results.

stories.headline: Italy reaches NATO 2% defense spending target through expanded budget classifications
stories.summary: Italy achieved the NATO 2% of GDP defense spending target in 2025 (2.01%) according to preliminary estimates, though analysis shows this was largely through reclassifying existing expenses rather than substantial new military capability investments. Personnel and pension costs saw the largest increases.

articles.title: L'Italia nel 2025 al 2,01% del Pil in difesa in base alle stime Nato

stories.headline: Opposition calls for Meloni to address Parliament following referendum defeat
stories.summary: Opposition parties including IV, PD, AVS, and M5S formally requested Prime Minister Meloni appear in Parliament to explain government direction following the referendum defeat and subsequent ministerial resignations. Meloni has not yet responded to the request.

articles.title: Iv-Pd-Avs-M5S, Meloni riferisca in Parlamento sulle linee del governo
Meloni venga in Parlamento

stories.headline: Post-referendum polling shows Fratelli d'Italia decline, opposition gains
stories.summary: Multiple polls following the referendum show Fratelli d'Italia losing support (down to 27-29%) while opposition parties gain ground, with PD rising to around 22% and M5S to 12-13%. The "campo largo" coalition appears competitive with the center-right for the first time in years.

stories.headline: EU Parliament approves controversial trade agreement with Mercosur
stories.summary: The European Parliament finalized procedures for provisional implementation of the trade agreement with Mercosur, which will enter force May 1st with reduced tariffs on goods. The deal has faced criticism from agricultural sectors concerned about competition from South American imports.
